t: This is the Royal Brompton Hospital, the largest specialist heart and lung medical centre in the United Kingdom. It's managed by Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust. Several notable people died here. Dame Margaret Turner-Warwick was a thoracic specialist, and the first woman president of the Royal College of Physicians. Molly Cox was a BBC children's television producer whose successes included Play School, Zokko! and Jackanory. The hotelier John Eaddie also died here, in 1981.
